fixture_notice: Synthetic local fixture for offline evaluation. South Fork Community Garden, its members, dates, and practices are fictional.
request: A routine seasonal care guide for March through November, not disaster response.
garden_facts: The west beds dry first; the rain barrel is shared and usually refilled after rain.
The accessible raised bed is reserved for shared crops and has a 30-minute watering task option.
The garden avoids synthetic pesticides; unknown pests are photographed and discussed before action.
Compost is turned on the first Saturday of each month when two people can work safely.

claims: Tomato staking was needed by late May last year; this is an observation, not a guaranteed date.
Water deeply when soil is dry below the surface; coordinate with the shared barrel and do not promise water availability.
Offer seated, paired, short, and observation-only tasks; no gardener is required to lift compost or use a tool.

unknowns: This year's rainfall, pest pressure, and volunteer availability are not known.
No medical, pesticide, or emergency procedure is supplied by the fixture.
